# Proverbs 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Proverbs-of Solomon. A-son wise gladdens a-father, but-a-son foolish [is the]-grief-of his-mother.

**2** Treasures-of wickedness do-not-profit, but-righteousness delivers from-death.

**3** Not will-YHWH-let-hunger the-soul-of [the]-righteous, but-[the]-desire-of [the]-wicked He-pushes-away.

**4** Poor [is one]-working [with a]-palm-of slackness, but-[the]-hand-of [the]-diligent makes-rich.

**5** One-gathering in-summer [is] a-son [who]-acts-wisely; one-sleeping in-harvest [is] a-son [who]-acts-shamefully.

**6** Blessings [are] for-[the]-head-of [the]-righteous, but-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked conceals violence.

**7** Memory-of [the]-righteous [is]-for-blessing, but-[the]-name-of [the]-wicked will-rot.

**8** Wise-of heart will-receive commandments, but-foolish-of lips will-be-thrown-down.

**9** One-walking in-integrity walks securely, but-one-making-crooked his-ways will-be-found-out.

**10** One-winking [the]-eye gives pain, and-foolish-of lips will-be-thrown-down.

**11** A-fountain-of life [is the]-mouth-of [the]-righteous, but-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked conceals violence.

**12** Hatred stirs-up contentions, but-over all transgressions love covers.

**13** On-[the]-lips-of [the]-discerning wisdom is-found, but-a-rod [is]-for-[the]-back-of one-lacking heart.

**14** Wise-ones store-up knowledge, but-[the]-mouth-of a-fool [is]-near destruction.

**15** Wealth-of a-rich-man [is] his-strong city; destruction-of poor-ones [is] their-poverty.

**16** Labor-of [the]-righteous [is] for-life; produce-of [the]-wicked [is] for-sin.

**17** A-path to-life [is one]-keeping discipline, but-one-forsaking correction goes-astray.

**18** One-concealing hatred [has]-lips-of falsehood, and-one-bringing-out slander — he [is] a-fool.

**19** In-[the]-multitude-of words transgression does-not-cease, but-one-restraining his-lips [acts]-wisely.

**20** Silver choice [is the]-tongue-of [the]-righteous; [the]-heart-of [the]-wicked [is]-like-little.

**21** Lips-of [the]-righteous feed many, but-fools for-lack-of heart die.

**22** Blessing-of YHWH — it makes-rich, and-toil does-not-add upon-it.

**23** Like-sport to-a-fool [is]-doing wickedness, but-wisdom [is] for-a-man-of understanding.

**24** What [the]-wicked dreads — it will-come to-him; but-[the]-desire-of [the]-righteous will-be-granted.

**25** When-[the]-whirlwind passes, [the]-wicked [is]-no-more, but-[the]-righteous [is an]-everlasting foundation.

**26** Like-vinegar to-the-teeth, and-like-smoke to-the-eyes, so [is] the-sluggard to-those-sending-him.

**27** Fear-of YHWH adds days, but-[the]-years-of [the]-wicked will-be-shortened.

**28** Hope-of [the]-righteous [is] joy, but-[the]-expectation-of [the]-wicked will-perish.

**29** [The]-way-of YHWH [is] a-stronghold for-[the]-blameless, but-destruction for-workers-of iniquity.

**30** [The]-righteous forever will-not-be-moved, but-[the]-wicked will-not-dwell in-[the]-land.

**31** [The]-mouth-of [the]-righteous bears-fruit-of wisdom, but-a-tongue-of perversities will-be-cut-off.

**32** Lips-of [the]-righteous know [what is]-acceptable, but-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked [speaks]-perversities.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **10:1**: Marks the beginning of the 'Proverbs of Solomon' proper — short, two-line antithetical parallelisms. The form dominates through ch. 22:16.

- **10:12**: Al kol pesha'im tekhasseh ahavah — 'over all transgressions love covers.' Cited in 1 Peter 4:8 and James 5:20.

- **10:22**: Birkat YHWH hi ta'ashir — 'the blessing of YHWH, it makes rich.' The pronoun 'it' (hi) is emphatic — it alone, without additional toil.

— EMET
